summary: WorkAdmissionPort::resume: the reconciliation-gated requeue transaction ported from WorkStore.resume, minus the transition-authority gates (bound provider/binary authorities are host objects the port does not carry; the no-authority native_timeout/reviewer_correction paths are the port's contract).
signature: pub(crate) fn resume(store: &crate::work_store::PgWorkStore, request: &forge_work::ResumeRequest) -> Result<forge_work::ControlOutcome, forge_work::WorkError>;
responsibilities: Validate expected_revision in 1..=MAX_REVISION and note <= 2048 UTF-8 bytes else rejected(400, invalid_request). intent = intent_digest({action: "resume", project_alias, task_id, expected_revision, agent_profile, reconciliation_receipt_id (string), note}).

In one transaction: advisory_lock. SELECT id, project_alias, mode, status, revision, latest_attempt_id, plan_decision_id, review_required, workflow_required, workflow_id, workflow_review_id FROM forge_agent.coding_tasks WHERE owner_id=$1 AND project_alias=$2 AND id=$3 FOR UPDATE; no row -> not_found. mode not in request.allowed_modes -> rejected(403, denied). Receipt replay as in accept (action resume) -> outcome_for(receipt.revision, true).

Gates: revision != expected or expected >= MAX_REVISION -> rejected(409, revision_conflict). publication_busy -> rejected(409, reconcile_required). review_required AND mode == implement AND a coding_reviews row exists for (task, latest_attempt_id) -> rejected(409, not_reviewable). (mode == plan AND status == awaiting_review) OR status in {queued, running, cancel_requested, completed} OR latest_attempt_id null -> rejected(409, reconcile_required).

Reconciliation receipt: SELECT receipt_id, attempt_id, task_revision, workspace_digest FROM forge_agent.coding_reconciliation_receipts WHERE owner_id=$1 AND project_alias=$2 AND task_id=$3 AND receipt_id=$4; missing -> rejected(409, reconcile_required); task_revision != task revision or attempt_id != latest_attempt_id -> rejected(409, stale_reconciliation). attempt_reservation query (pinned): reserved > 0 or not attempt_stopped -> rejected(409, reconcile_required). Pending cap as in submit -> rejected(503, queue_full).

Recipe document via pinned_recipe_for(request.recipe_digest); None -> rejected(503, unavailable). UPDATE (pinned) with review_required = (mode == "implement"); no row -> rejected(409, revision_conflict). receipt = {project_alias, task_id, base_revision: expected, revision: new, status: "queued", recipe_digest}. Event payload = {base_revision, revision, agent_profile, recipe_digest, reconciliation_receipt_id (string), workspace_digest} plus note when non-empty; insert_event(kind resumed). INSERT control receipt (action resume). notify. outcome_for(new_revision, false).
invariants: The resumed event kind is resumed; the task returns to queued with the reconciliation workspace digest pinned.
